ModMetaData.name: VFEM2 - Merchant Guild Landing Fix
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description:
Vehicle Framework aircraft can fly to Vanilla Factions Expanded - Medieval 2's travelling merchant guild.
Without this, the guild is not a destination Vehicle Framework recognises, so targeting it offers nothing. With it, targeting the guild offers "Form caravan here": the aircraft lands on the guild's tile as a caravan, which can then trade with it.
Originally part of Too Many Mods - Compats and Rebalances by Warachia.
